title: Picatrix (Ghāyat al-Ḥakīm)
sourceTradition: Medieval Arabic astral magic and its Latin reception
historicalPeriod: Arabic composition commonly dated to the tenth or eleventh century; Latin translation tradition from the thirteenth century

rightsNotes: Open reading access does not establish commercial-reuse permission for the 1986 critical edition; modern English translations are separately copyrighted.
limitations: No modern translation may be copied or closely paraphrased without a compatible license.
Many recipes use hazardous substances or animal materials and cannot be presented as modern instructions.

title: Greek Magical Papyri (Papyri Graecae Magicae)
sourceTradition: Greco-Egyptian ritual practice of the Hellenistic and Roman periods
historicalPeriod: Primary papyri mainly second century BCE through fifth century CE; modern editions vary

rightsNotes: The commonly used Betz English translation is a modern copyrighted publication. A reusable primary-text edition and translation must be selected before use.
limitations: PGM is a corpus, not one manuscript; every lesson must identify the papyrus and lines.
Coercive, toxic, medical, and animal-use recipes are excluded from direct adaptation.
